principal.definition: Source-qualified scalars and documented one-sided limits. Site ranges, patch maxima, uncertain positions, alternative correlations and count-only deposits remain in the evidence ledger.

range_low.definition: Use lower endpoints of reported numerical site ranges as a joint sensitivity.

range_high.definition: Use upper endpoints of the same ranges as a joint sensitivity.

correlations.definition: Attribute the whole 150 cm summit stack and both 26 cm Dongfanghong units to primary Millennium fall.

target: Combined Millennium airfall, including primary ash settling from pyroclastic clouds. Preserved thickness can differ from primary ground deposition.
source_coordinates: Original coordinate precision varies. No survey datum transformation is claimed.
original_csv_notes: 84 positive rows, 7 flagged artificial rows (86–92), and 6 off-schema triplets in H:J (rows 1–6). Synthetic rows and orphan values do not enter the principal input.
